title: Privacy in this local preview
lead: This preview is intended for synthetic enquiries, not real customer data.
description: Its local fixture receiver does not send email or connect to a provider. A production privacy notice still needs an assigned owner and approved facts.

sections.title: Form handling
paragraphs: A successful test request is retained only in process memory for up to 24 hours and disappears when the server restarts. The page does not put form text in a URL, cookie or browser storage.

sections.title: Email alternative
paragraphs: The email link opens your own mail application. Handling then depends on that application and the eventual mailbox operator; neither is verified in this preview.

sections.title: No tracking in this build
paragraphs: The local website includes no analytics or third-party font requests. Production delivery and retention policies require separate review.
